title: PROTESTS AND SOCIAL CHANGE
description: Introduces core theoretical and methodological issues related to social movements in the US and abroad. Emphasizes social forces giving rise to movements, tactics employed by movements, and impacts of them on society. CROSSLISTED as PPOL 471/SOC 471.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: MW 10am-11:50am in STAG 213 - Strand Agriculture Hall 213 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
